blocks.title: Key vocabulary
items: multicore — Processor with multiple CPU cores.
parallelism — Simultaneous processing of independent tasks.
Amdahl's law — Speedup bounded by serial portion.

blocks.title: Understand
blocks.text: A multicore CPU integrates two or more processing cores, which can execute independent threads concurrently.

blocks.title: Apply
blocks.text: Parallel processing can reduce completion time when tasks can be divided; a serial dependency is a critical-path constraint.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Shared memory bandwidth, locking, thread scheduling and the serial proportion of a program limit speedup. More cores do not guarantee proportional gains.
